# Gym & Training Expert Skill for Muse

A deep, research-grounded training guide covering progressive overload, hypertrophy mechanisms, volume and frequency landmarks (MEV/MRV), intensity zones, biomechanics and lifting form, periodization, and recovery — plus worked-out programs for beginner, intermediate, and advanced lifters, common mistakes, and injury-prevention guidance. It reads like a coach's reference manual rather than a motivational poster: definitions first, programming second. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: it is gym-centered (barbells and dumbbells, not home workouts) and fairly dense — better suited to regular lifters than to absolute beginners. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
